description: This file is part of the 'astor' library for Python AST manipulation, providing data and functions for mapping AST nodes to symbols and precedences, including definitions of operators, their symbols, and precedences.

classes.name: Precedence
classes.description: A class encapsulating operator precedence data and highest precedence value.

methods.name: get_op_symbol
methods.description: Returns a string symbol for a given AST node object.

methods.name: get_op_precedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence value for a given AST node object.
